scripts.dev: npm run dev:verify && npm run dev:serve
scripts.dev:verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run build:web
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.check: npm run check -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:web && npm run sync -w apps/mobile
scripts.mobile:build: npm run build:web && npm run sync -w apps/mobile && npm run apk:debug -w apps/mobile
scripts.mobile:verify: npm run check && npm run build:web && (test -d apps/mobile/android || npm run add:android -w apps/mobile) && npm run sync -w apps/mobile && npm run verify:android -w apps/mobile
scripts.web:check: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/web
